semantic_requirements.title: Atomic Ledger Transaction Boundary
semantic_requirements.description: Execute financial entries inside an atomic all-or-nothing transaction boundary.

semantic_requirements.title: Double-Entry Balance Invariance
semantic_requirements.description: Ensure sum of all debits strictly equals sum of all credits for every transaction.

semantic_requirements.title: Idempotency Key Verification
semantic_requirements.description: Verify idempotency keys to prevent duplicate execution of ledger transactions.

semantic_requirements.title: Disallow Negative Amount / Non-Zero Transfer Guard
semantic_requirements.description: Validate that transaction debit and credit amounts are strictly positive non-zero numbers before execution.
why_chain: Negative transfer amounts invert accounting polarity
Pre-condition input validation protects balance integrity

semantic_requirements.title: Row-Level Account Locking and Concurrency Control
semantic_requirements.description: Acquire serializable row-level locks on affected account balances to prevent race conditions.

semantic_requirements.title: Append-Only Immutable Audit Log
semantic_requirements.description: Record all ledger entries to an append-only journal with zero in-place updates.
